```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
library(datasets)
library(tidymodels)
library(tidyverse)
library(rpart.plot)
library(caret)
library(ggforce)
```

```{r}
irises <- as_tibble(iris)

irises
```

```{r}
irises$Species %>% unique()

iris_split <- initial_split(irises, prop = 0.75)

train <- training(iris_split)

test <- testing(iris_split)

train

test
```

```{r}
ggplot(data = irises, aes(x = .panel_x, y = .panel_y)) + 
  geom_point(aes(color = Species)) + 
  geom_autodensity(aes(fill = Species)) + 
  geom_boxplot(aes(fill = Species)) + 
  facet_matrix(vars(Sepal.Length:Petal.Width), 
               layer.lower = 1, 
               layer.diag = 2, 
               layer.upper = 3)

ggplot(data = train, aes(x = .panel_x, y = .panel_y)) + 
  geom_point(aes(color = Species)) + 
  geom_autodensity(aes(fill = Species)) + 
  geom_boxplot(aes(fill = Species)) + 
  facet_matrix(vars(Sepal.Length:Petal.Width), 
               layer.lower = 1, 
               layer.diag = 2, 
               layer.upper = 3)

ggplot(data = test, aes(x = .panel_x, y = .panel_y)) + 
  geom_point(aes(color = Species)) + 
  geom_autodensity(aes(fill = Species)) + 
  geom_boxplot(aes(fill = Species)) + 
  facet_matrix(vars(Sepal.Length:Petal.Width), 
               layer.lower = 1, 
               layer.diag = 2, 
               layer.upper = 3)
```

```{r}
ggplot(filter(train, Species != "setosa")) + geom_point(aes(x = Petal.Length, y = Petal.Width, color = Species), size = 3) + scale_color_manual(values = c("#00BA38", "#619CFF"))
```

```{r}
dtree_mod <- decision_tree(mode = "classification", min_n = 4, tree_depth = 3)

dtree_mod_fit <- fit(object = dtree_mod, formula = Species ~ ., data = train)

dtree_mod_fit %>% extract_fit_engine() %>% rpart.plot()
``` 

```{r}
predictions <- predict(dtree_mod_fit, new_data = test)

confusionMatrix(data = predictions$.pred_class, reference = test$Species)

dtree_mod_fit %>% extract_fit_engine() %>% varImp()
```

```{r}
dtree_mod_fit2 <- dtree_mod %>% fit(Species ~ Petal.Length + Petal.Width, data = train)

dtree_mod_fit2

dtree_mod_fit2 %>% extract_fit_engine() %>% rpart.plot()

predictions2 <- predict(dtree_mod_fit2, new_data = test)

confusionMatrix(data = predictions2$.pred_class, reference = test$Species)

dtree_mod_fit2 %>% extract_fit_engine() %>% varImp()
```

```{r}
dtree_mod_hyper <- decision_tree(mode = "classification",
                                 min_n = 1, tree_depth = 4,
                                 cost_complexity = 0)

dtree_mod_hyper_fit <- dtree_mod_hyper %>%
  fit(Species ~ Petal.Length + Petal.Width, data = train)

dtree_mod_hyper_fit %>% extract_fit_engine() %>% rpart.plot()
```

```{r}
#Cohen's Kappa
#<= 0.2, no reliability
#0.21 to 0.39, minimal reliability
#0.40 to 0.59, weak reliability
#0.60 to 0.79, moderate reliability
#0.80 to 0.90, strong reliability
#>0.90, nearly perfect reliability

predictions <- predict(dtree_mod_fit, new_data = test)

confusionMatrix(data = predictions$.pred_class, reference = test$Species)

predictions_hyper <- predict(dtree_mod_hyper_fit, new_data = test)

confusionMatrix(data = predictions_hyper$.pred_class, reference = test$Species)
```
